title: Bounded-fanout equivalent circuit
statement: Let $C$ be a directed acyclic Boolean circuit on $n$ inputs in which each gate has no repeated arguments, every NOT gate has exactly one argument, and every gate has at most two arguments. There is a circuit $C'$ on the same inputs satisfying these conditions, such that each vertex is an argument of at most two gates, $C'$ computes the same Boolean function as $C$, and the size of $C'$ is at most three times the size of $C$.
hypotheses_covered: C is a DAG circuit on n inputs
Each gate has no repeated arguments
Every NOT gate has exactly one argument
Every gate has at most two arguments
